$comment: Curated column detail for Billing, Tax, Issuing and Radar tables. Same confidence rules as curated_core.json.

subscriptions.description: One row per Subscription object. The primary Billing table alongside invoices.
subscriptions.grain: One row per subscription, including canceled ones.

columns.name: price_id
columns.description: Price on the subscription. Only meaningful for single-item subscriptions; use subscription_items for multi-item ones.

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: Legacy plan identifier, retained for older integrations.

columns.name: current_period_start
columns.description: Start of the current billing period.

columns.name: current_period_end
columns.description: End of the current billing period.

columns.name: ended_at
columns.description: When the subscription ended, if it has.

columns.name: cancel_at_period_end
columns.description: Whether the subscription will cancel at the end of the current period.

columns.name: billing_cycle_anchor
columns.description: Anchor determining when invoices are generated.

columns.name: discounts
columns.description: Comma-separated discount ids applied to the subscription. Split and unnest to join to discounts.

columns.name: default_payment_method_id
columns.description: Payment method used to bill the subscription.

notes: discounts is a comma-separated string, not an array. Unnest it: cross join unnest(split(discounts, ',')) as t(discount_id).
For MRR and churn, use subscription_item_change_events rather than deriving from status transitions.

subscription_items.description: Individual priced items on a subscription. A subscription with multiple products has one row per product here.

columns.name: price_product_id
columns.description: Product behind the price. Denormalized so you can join products without going through prices.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Quantity of the price on this item.

notes: price_product_id lets you join straight to products — you don't need to hop through prices.

invoices.description: One row per Invoice object. Each subscription generates invoices on a recurring basis covering the subscription amount plus any invoice items.
invoices.grain: One row per invoice, including drafts and voided invoices.

columns.name: subscription_id
columns.description: Subscription that generated the invoice, if any.

columns.name: charge_id
columns.description: Charge that paid the invoice, if any.

columns.name: payment_intent_id
columns.description: PaymentIntent used to pay the invoice.

columns.name: subtotal
columns.description: Total before discounts and tax, in minor units.

columns.name: total
columns.description: Final total after discounts and tax, in minor units.

columns.name: amount_due
columns.description: Amount still owed, in minor units.

columns.name: amount_paid
columns.description: Amount paid so far, in minor units.

columns.name: amount_remaining
columns.description: Amount left to pay, in minor units.

columns.name: period_start
columns.description: Start of the billing period this invoice covers.

columns.name: period_end
columns.description: End of the billing period this invoice covers.

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: Payment due date for send_invoice collection.

columns.name: paid
columns.description: Whether the invoice has been paid.

notes: period_start/period_end describe the service period, which often differs from created. Use the right one for revenue reporting.

invoice_line_items.description: Individual line items on an invoice.
invoice_line_items.grain: One row per invoice line item.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Polymorphic id of what generated the line: a subscription (sub_...) or an invoice item (ii_...). Use source_type to disambiguate.

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: Whether the line came from a subscription or an invoice item.

columns.name: subscription_id
columns.description: Subscription the line belongs to, if any.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Line amount in minor currency units.

columns.name: period_start
columns.description: Start of the service period for this line.

columns.name: period_end
columns.description: End of the service period for this line.

columns.name: proration
columns.description: Whether this line is a proration adjustment.

notes: source_id is polymorphic — always filter on source_type before joining it to subscriptions or invoice_items.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether the product is currently available.

columns.name: statement_descriptor
columns.description: Text shown on the customer's card statement.

columns.name: unit_label
columns.description: Label for a single unit, e.g. 'seat'.

prices.description: How much and how often to charge for a product.

columns.name: unit_amount
columns.description: Amount charged per unit, in minor currency units. Null for tiered pricing.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether the price can be used for new purchases.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Whether the price is one-off or recurring.

columns.name: recurring_usage_type
columns.description: Whether usage is metered or a fixed quantity.

columns.name: tiers_mode
columns.description: How tiers apply when billing_scheme is tiered.

notes: When billing_scheme is 'tiered', unit_amount is null and the real pricing lives in price_tiers.

price_tiers.description: Tier definitions for prices using tiered billing.
price_tiers.grain: One row per tier of a price.

columns.name: upto
columns.description: Upper bound of the tier in units. Null represents the unbounded final tier.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Per-unit amount for this tier, in minor currency units.

columns.name: flat_amount
columns.description: Flat fee charged for this tier, in minor currency units.

coupons.description: Discount definitions that can be applied to customers, subscriptions or invoices.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Coupon identifier — often a human-chosen string rather than a generated id.

columns.name: amount_off
columns.description: Fixed discount in minor currency units. Mutually exclusive with percent_off.

columns.name: percent_off
columns.description: Percentage discount. Mutually exclusive with amount_off.

columns.name: duration_in_months
columns.description: Number of months the discount applies when duration is repeating.

columns.name: max_redemptions
columns.description: Maximum number of times the coupon can be redeemed.

columns.name: times_redeemed
columns.description: Number of times the coupon has been redeemed.

columns.name: valid
columns.description: Whether the coupon can still be applied.

discounts.description: Applications of a coupon or promotion code to a customer, subscription or invoice.

columns.name: promotion_code_id
columns.description: Promotion code used, if the discount came from one.

columns.name: end
columns.description: When the discount stops applying. `end` is a reserved word in Trino — quote it as "end".

notes: Reach discounts from subscriptions by unnesting the comma-separated subscriptions.discounts column.

promotion_codes.description: Customer-facing codes that map to a coupon.

columns.name: created
columns.description: When the promotion code was created (UTC).

columns.name: code
columns.description: The code customers type in, e.g. SPRING25.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer the code is restricted to, if any.

columns.name: active
columns.description: Whether the code can still be redeemed.

columns.name: times_redeemed
columns.description: Number of times the code has been redeemed.

subscription_item_change_events.description: Pre-computed MRR movement events. Stripe's recommended basis for MRR, churn and expansion reporting — far more reliable than deriving movements from subscription status changes.
subscription_item_change_events.grain: One row per change to a subscription item that moves MRR.

columns.name: local_event_timestamp
columns.description: When the change took effect, in your account's local time.

columns.name: mrr_change
columns.description: Signed change in monthly recurring revenue, in minor currency units.

notes: Cumulatively sum mrr_change per customer ordered by local_event_timestamp to reconstruct MRR at any point in time.
subscription_item_change_events_v2_beta has the same columns with 3-hour freshness instead of 24-hour.
Values are per-currency. Convert with exchange_rates_from_usd before summing across currencies.

exchange_rates_from_usd.description: Daily currency conversion rates expressed relative to USD. Needed to sum multi-currency amounts into one reporting currency.

columns.name: buy_currency_exchange_rates
columns.description: JSON object mapping currency code to rate per 1 USD. Parse with cast(json_parse(buy_currency_exchange_rates) as map(varchar, double)).

notes: This is a JSON string column, not a map. Parse it before use.
To convert an amount from currency A to currency B: amount / rate[A] * rate[B].

billing_meters.description: Usage-based billing meters that aggregate metered events.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Meter status. Note the documented example filters on the uppercase value 'ACTIVE'.

columns.name: default_aggregation_formula
columns.description: How events are aggregated, e.g. sum or count.

columns.name: event_name
columns.description: Name of the event this meter listens for.

notes: status is uppercase in this table ('ACTIVE'), unlike most Sigma enum columns which are lowercase.

billing_meter_event_summaries.description: Aggregated meter usage per customer over a time window.

columns.name: aggregated_value
columns.description: Aggregated usage value for the window.

columns.name: start_time
columns.description: Inclusive start of the summary window.

columns.name: end_time
columns.description: Exclusive end of the summary window.

columns.name: value_grouping_window
columns.description: Granularity of the window, e.g. 'hourly' or 'daily'.

notes: Always filter on value_grouping_window or you will double count across granularities.

billing_meter_invalid_events.description: Meter events that failed validation and were not counted toward usage.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the invalid event.

columns.name: created
columns.description: When the invalid event was received (UTC).

notes: The original event payload is in billing_meter_invalid_events_payload, joined on event_id.

billing_meter_invalid_events_payload.description: Key/value payload of each invalid meter event.
billing_meter_invalid_events_payload.grain: One row per (invalid event, payload key).

columns.name: event_id
columns.description: The invalid event this payload entry belongs to.

tax_transactions.description: Records of assumed or reduced tax liability. The recommended starting point for tax reporting, and the bridge between tax tables and invoices or checkout sessions.
tax_transactions.grain: One row per tax transaction, one-to-one with its source object.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Polymorphic id of the object that triggered the calculation, e.g. an invoice (in_...) or checkout session (cs_...).

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: Type of the source object, e.g. 'invoice'.

columns.name: tax_date
columns.description: Date used to determine applicable tax rules.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Integration currency for the transaction's amounts.

columns.name: type
columns.description: Whether this records a sale or a reversal.

notes: Join to invoices or checkout_sessions on source_id, filtering by source_type first.

tax_transaction_line_items.description: Line items contributing to the sale of goods for a tax transaction.
tax_transaction_line_items.grain: One row per tax line item.

columns.name: source_line_item_id
columns.description: The invoice or checkout line item this corresponds to.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Gross line amount in minor units. Includes tax when tax_behavior is inclusive, excludes it when exclusive.

columns.name: amount_tax
columns.description: Tax liability for this line, in minor units.

columns.name: tax_code
columns.description: Tax code applied. Joins to tax_codes.id.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Integration currency defining amount and amount_tax. Do not sum across currencies.

columns.name: quantity_decimal
columns.description: Quantity billed, as a decimal string.

notes: Net sales excluding tax = case when tax_behavior = 'inclusive' then amount - amount_tax else amount end.

tax_transaction_shipping_costs.description: Shipping costs contributing to a tax transaction. Structurally parallel to tax_transaction_line_items.
tax_transaction_shipping_costs.grain: One row per shipping cost. A tax transaction has at most one.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Gross shipping amount in minor units.

columns.name: amount_tax
columns.description: Tax liability on shipping, in minor units.

notes: Shipping costs have no source_line_item_id and no quantity — union them with line items using literal placeholders.

tax_transaction_jurisdiction_details.description: Per-jurisdiction breakdown of the tax liability for a tax transaction item.
tax_transaction_jurisdiction_details.grain: One row per (tax transaction item, jurisdiction).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Identifier of the tax transaction item these details belong to.

columns.name: tax_transaction_item_id
columns.description: The line item or shipping cost this jurisdiction detail applies to.

columns.name: tax_transaction_item_type
columns.description: Whether the item is a line item or a shipping cost.

columns.name: amount_taxable
columns.description: Portion of the item amount that is taxable in this jurisdiction, in minor units.

columns.name: amount_non_taxable
columns.description: Portion of the item amount that is non-taxable in this jurisdiction, in minor units.

columns.name: amount_tax
columns.description: Tax owed to this jurisdiction, in minor units. Summing across jurisdictions equals the item's amount_tax.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: Integration currency for the amount_* columns.

columns.name: filing_currency
columns.description: Currency the tax authority requires for filing.

columns.name: filing_amount_taxable
columns.description: amount_taxable expressed in the filing currency.

columns.name: filing_amount_non_taxable
columns.description: amount_non_taxable expressed in the filing currency.

columns.name: filing_amount_tax
columns.description: amount_tax expressed in the filing currency.

columns.name: jurisdiction_name
columns.description: Name of the jurisdiction, e.g. California.

columns.name: jurisdiction_country
columns.description: Two-letter ISO country of the jurisdiction.

columns.name: taxability_reason
columns.description: Why the item was taxed this way, e.g. standard_rated, not_subject_to_tax.

columns.name: tax_type
columns.description: Type of tax, e.g. sales_tax, vat, gst.

columns.name: tax_rate_percentage
columns.description: Rate applied by this jurisdiction, as a percentage.

notes: Summing amount_taxable or amount_non_taxable across jurisdictions does NOT equal the item's amount — jurisdictions overlap. Only amount_tax sums correctly.
US country-level rows are always non-taxable; exclude them to match Stripe's itemized tax export.

tax_codes.description: Product categories Stripe Tax uses to determine tax treatment. Contains all generally available tax codes, not just ones you use.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Longer explanation of what the code covers.

issuing_authorizations.description: Authorization requests created whenever an issued card is used. Includes declined attempts.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Authorized amount in minor currency units.

columns.name: merchant_name
columns.description: Merchant the card was used at.

columns.name: merchant_country
columns.description: Two-letter ISO country of the merchant.

notes: The API's request_history field is not available in Sigma.

issuing_transactions.description: Uses of an issued card that actually moved funds, such as completed purchases and refunds.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Amount in minor currency units. Negative for captures (money leaving your account).

columns.name: authorization_id
columns.description: Authorization this transaction settles. Empty for force captures and some refunds.

columns.name: balance_transaction_id
columns.description: Balance transaction recording the effect on your balance, including fees.

columns.name: merchant_name
columns.description: Merchant the card was used at.

notes: amount is negative for captures, so an over-capture check compares -1 * issuing_transactions.amount against issuing_authorizations.amount.
authorization_id can be empty — use a left join if you need every transaction.

columns.name: last4
columns.description: Last four digits of the card number.

notes: The API's spending_controls field is not available in Sigma.

issuing_cardholders.description: People or businesses that hold cards you have issued.
notes: Documented examples show a 'business_entity' value for type alongside 'individual'; the API uses 'company'. Verify against your own data before filtering.

radar_rules.description: Radar for Fraud Teams custom rules, with their action and predicate. Built-in Stripe rules have fixed ids.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Rule identifier. Built-in rules use fixed string ids such as allow_if_in_allowlist.

columns.name: predicate
columns.description: The rule expression as written in Radar.

notes: Join to rule_decisions on rule_id to find every payment a rule affected — broader than charges.outcome_rule_id, which misses 3DS rules on PaymentIntents and SetupIntents.

rule_decisions.description: Every Radar rule evaluation, including 3DS rules triggered on PaymentIntents and SetupIntents.

columns.name: action
columns.description: Action the rule took, e.g. request_credentials.

columns.name: charge_id
columns.description: Charge the decision applied to, if any.

columns.name: setup_intent_id
columns.description: SetupIntent the decision applied to, if any.

radar_rule_attributes.description: Snapshot of most Radar rule attribute values as evaluated for a single charge. Useful for backtesting rules against known outcomes.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.description: The charge these attributes were evaluated for. Joins to charges.id and to disputes.charge_id.

columns.name: cvc_check
columns.description: CVC verification result at evaluation time.

columns.name: is_3d_secure_authenticated
columns.description: Whether the payment was authenticated with 3D Secure.

columns.name: total_charges_per_card_number_all_time
columns.description: Lifetime charge count seen for this card number.

notes: The full attribute list mirrors Radar's supported rule attributes and is wider than what is listed here.
Join to disputes on radar_rule_attributes.transaction_id = disputes.charge_id to profile disputed traffic.

authentication_report_attempts.description: Individual 3D Secure authentication attempts, including the resulting charge outcome.
authentication_report_attempts.grain: One row per authentication attempt. An intent can have several.

columns.name: intent_id
columns.description: PaymentIntent or SetupIntent the attempt belongs to.

columns.name: is_final_attempt
columns.description: Whether this was the last attempt for the intent. Filter on this to avoid double counting.

columns.name: threeds_outcome_result
columns.description: Result of the 3DS challenge, e.g. authenticated.

columns.name: charge_outcome
columns.description: What happened to the charge afterwards, e.g. authorized.

icplus_fees.description: Interchange-plus fee breakdown, splitting each fee into interchange, scheme and Stripe components.
icplus_fees.grain: One row per fee component tied to a balance transaction.

columns.name: balance_transaction_id
columns.description: Balance transaction that debited the fee.

columns.name: balance_transaction_created_at
columns.description: When the balance transaction hit your balance (UTC).

notes: Only populated for accounts on interchange-plus pricing.
